title: I built a free tool to help indies plan Steam localization (v0.8.2 beta) it doesn't solve everything, but I’d love to shape it together with you
author: CoffeeTownIst
selftext:
I’ve seen so many beginners and solo devs around me struggle with where to even begin when it comes to Steam marketing and localization. Worse, I've seen people pay good money out of pocket for translations, only to run into major headaches and zero return because they targeted the wrong markets.

To help with that, I put together a lightweight tool to give developers a clear, practical starting point. To be completely upfront, it’s not a magic bullet and it won't solve every publishing hurdle. But I genuinely believe it's a solid first step to keep people from blindly burning through their budget.

The tool (named LocEngine) is currently in open beta at **v0.8.1**. Aimed at helping indie developers plan their Steam localization and target the right regional markets.

More than anything, I don't want to build this in a vacuum I want to develop and refine it together with the community. At the end of the day, this is a tool meant for all of us to use. I'm going to keep rolling out updates, and I would love to hear your thoughts:

* Which languages or regional markets do you think are missing or misweighted?
* What features, data points, or filters would make this truly indispensable for your release planning?
* What feels off or unnecessary right now?

Drop your honest feedback, critiques, and ideas below. I'll be reading through everything and tweaking the tool based on what the community actually needs.  
[https://coffeetown.itch.io/steam-localization-calculator](https://coffeetown.itch.io/steam-localization-calculator)
